card.label: App {{name}}
card.typecheckWarning_one: {{count}} type error. This version still runs; ask Atd to fix it.
card.typecheckWarning_other: {{count}} type errors. This version still runs; ask Atd to fix them.
card.failed: The build failed. The current version still runs.

panel.label: My apps
panel.emptyDescription: Ask Atd to build one, such as a habit tracker or a budget sheet.

pin.addHint: Pin to Desktop (or drag the card there)
pin.dragHint: Next time, drag an app's card onto the desktop to pin it.
pin.loginHint: Pins show while Atd runs; turn on Open at login to keep them after a restart.

consent.title: {{app}} wants to {{capability}}
consent.remembered: Atd remembers your choice for this app. Change it in Settings › Apps.

ai.label: AI models
ai.consent: Sends prompts to the model provider you set up in Atd. Usage is billed to that provider account.

agent.label: Agent
agent.description: Steps with side effects still ask for approval.
agent.consent: Runs tasks with tools, skills and subagents. Steps with side effects still ask for your approval.

memory.label: Memory
memory.consent: Searches, reads and saves entries in your long-term memory.

mcp.label: MCP servers
mcp.description: Calls tools on your MCP servers.
mcp.consent: Lists and calls tools on the MCP servers you connected in Atd.

web.label: Web search and fetch
web.description: Searches the web and fetches pages.
web.consent: Runs web searches and fetches pages through Atd.

rename.title: Rename app
rename.description: The new name shows in your apps and on the app's window.
rename.label: Name

confirm.deleteDescription: The app, every version and all of its data are deleted, and its window closes. This can't be undone.
confirm.clearDescription: Everything the app saved is removed and its window closes. The app and its versions stay.
confirm.revertDescription: Version {{version}} is published again as the newest version. The app's data is not rolled back, so data saved by later versions may not work with it.

feedback.reverted: Version {{version}} is current again, as version {{current}}

settings.title: Apps
settings.description: Apps you built with Atd. Open one, go back to an earlier version, or change what it can use.
settings.emptyDescription: Describe an app in the task panel and Atd builds it. It shows up here when the first version is ready.

versions.title: Versions
versions.footer: Each change you ask for becomes one version, however many builds it takes. Reverting makes an older one current; newer versions stay listed.

widgets.title: Widgets
widgets.footer: Add “App Widget” from Atd in the macOS widget gallery, then choose “{{name}}”.
widgets.unavailable: Move Atd to the Applications folder to use its widgets.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.footer: Atd asks the first time the app uses each capability. Storage and logs need no permission.
permissions.none: This app uses no AI models, agent tasks, memory, MCP tools or web access.

data.title: Data
data.footer: The app's own database, files and browser storage live in its data folder.
data.clearDescription: Deletes the app's database, files and browser storage. Versions and permissions stay.
data.deleteDescription: Removes the app, all versions, its data and its widgets. This cannot be undone.
